description: Autonomous Mode configuration for Agentic Substrate

tasks.name: Self-Improvement Cycle
tasks.description: Review codebase, identify improvements, implement with tests
tasks.prompt: Review the codebase for improvements. Focus on: code quality, test coverage, documentation gaps, and performance. Make only safe, minimal changes. Commit each improvement separately with clear messages.

tasks.name: Test Suite Runner
tasks.description: Run test suite and fix any failures
tasks.prompt: Run the full test suite. If any tests fail, investigate and fix the root cause. Do not skip or delete failing tests. Commit fixes with clear messages.

tasks.name: Dependency Updater
tasks.description: Check and update dependencies to latest compatible versions
tasks.prompt: Check for outdated dependencies. Update them one at a time, running tests after each update. Revert any update that breaks tests. Commit successful updates individually.

schedule._description: Interval for systemd timer. Persistent catches up after downtime. Delay prevents API thundering herd.

rate_limit._max_session_percent_description: Use up to this % of the session budget before pausing (1-100)
rate_limit._session_budget_description: Total budget per session window. Set to your API plan's limit or desired cap.
rate_limit._session_window_description: Length of one session window in hours. Usage resets after this period.
rate_limit._pause_between_tasks_description: Seconds to wait between consecutive tasks (prevents burst requests)
rate_limit._wait_for_reset_description: If true, sleep until the session window resets. If false, exit and let systemd timer retry later.
rate_limit._tracking_file_description: File to track cumulative usage across runs within a session window

model._description: Use Sonnet for cost efficiency in autonomous runs. Override with Opus for complex tasks.

_system_prompt_description: Path to custom CLAUDE.md. If empty, uses CLAUDE-autonomous.md from install location.
